Choose Wholesome Cereals (continued)

Given that 10 percent of daily calories can appropriately come from sugar,
the 9 grams (36 calories) of sugar in Oatmeal Squares could certainly fit
into your day’s 200- to 300-calorie sugar budget. Sugar is a carbohydrate
that fuels the muscles; it doesn’t poison them. | invite you to focus more
on a cereal’s fiber and whole-grain content than on its sugar content. The
overall healthfulness of a breakfast cereal can outweigh those few nutri-
tionally empty sugar calories (figure 3.1).
